March 4, 2025

Senator Nangle, Representative Crafts, and esteemed members of the Joint Standing
Committee on Taxation: I am Senator Rick Bennett of Oxford, and I have the honor of serving 14 communities in Western Maine in the State Senate. I am pleased to sponsor LD 463, "Resolve, to Rename the New Ten Mile River Bridge on Pequawket Trail in Brownfield the Brownfield Veterans Memorial Bridge" and LD 464, "Resolve, to Rename the Brackett
Mill Bridge in Denmark the Brackett Mill Veterans Memorial Bridge."
E
These bills are part of an effort to renanie several bridges across the state to honor our
veterans. Bridges literally connect communities. For those who cross over them, the new names for these bridges will serve as a daily reminder of the incredible sacrifice made by those who have served our country.
I have attached letters from both Brownfield and Denmark supporting these changes. I fully back the effort to rename these bridges and recognize the great debt we all owe those who
fought to defend our country.
Thank you for your consideration. I urge you to vote "ought to pass" on LD 463 and LD 464.
